hook.name: MyNewHook
hook.description: A dynamic-fee Uniswap v4 hook that tracks tick changes across four timeframes (5min, 15min, 30min, 1h) using EWMA smoothing to classify pools into four volatility regimes, then adjusts LP fees between 0.01% and 2.00% via lpFeeOverride and updateDynamicLPFee. Fees are further adjusted ±10% based on current liquidity depth.
